answer: Each epoch a public lottery grants a limited number of mesa plots, one per winning identity and not transferable. To keep a plot, the holder must post a fresh yarrow cutting: a unique, non-reusable work sample hashed against that plot and epoch. Recycled cuttings or two names sharing a plot are evicted. A farm cannot grow a vine of clones across the mesa because plot issuance is capped and duplicate cuttings are public.
